name: niedenthal-lab-video-call
description: Three-seat research video call (two participants + invisible researcher) with live face/voice modification, full session logging, and stream recording (Niedenthal Emotions Lab, UW-Madison)
author: Niedenthal Emotions Lab

scripts.renderer:dev: npm run voice:build && next dev renderer -p 8888
scripts.voice:test: npm run voice:build && tsx --test tests/voice_contract_test.ts tests/voice_server_test.ts && node scripts/test-voice-audio.mjs
scripts.test: tsx tests/calibration_contract_test.ts && tsx tests/morph_contract_test.ts && tsx tests/expression_contract_test.ts && tsx tests/calibration_replay_test.ts
scripts.build: npm run voice:build && npm run clean && nextron build
scripts.build:win: npm run voice:build && npm run clean && nextron build --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run voice:build && npm run clean && nextron build --mac
